days.note: Mercy is new not because yesterday went well, but because it didn't — and that is exactly why today needs fresh mercy.
days.prayer: Lord, let me not drag yesterday's failure into today. I receive this morning's new mercy.

days.note: 'While we were yet sinners.' There is no conditional clause. He did not wait for us to be ready.
days.prayer: Let me believe today that I am not loved after I improve, but before.

days.note: David did not ask for his circumstances to be fixed. He asked for a heart to be created.
days.prayer: Create in me the heart I cannot repair myself.

days.note: 'I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.' Belonging comes first — not achievement.
days.prayer: Let my identity rest on your call, not on my usefulness.

days.note: Weakness was not the obstacle to grace but the channel of it. Paul carried that thorn to the end.
days.prayer: Let me see your power inside the weakness that never left.

days.note: The father ran before the son finished his speech. The quality of the repentance was not the condition of the welcome.
days.prayer: I trust that the Father runs while I am still on the road back.

days.note: As far as the east is from the west — north and south meet at the poles; east and west never meet.
days.prayer: Keep me from picking back up what you have already carried away.

days.note: The qualification is being weary and heavy laden. Not merit — exhaustion.
days.prayer: Teach me to rest today; I have forgotten how.

days.note: A gift stops being a gift the moment you repay it. Do not convert grace into debt.
days.prayer: Keep me from wearing myself out trying to repay what was given.

days.note: You walk *through* the valley. You do not live there. And you do not walk it alone.
days.prayer: Let me sense your presence in the valley I am walking now.

days.note: Confession is not informing God. It is agreeing with what He already knows.
days.prayer: Let me stop spending my strength on hiding.

days.note: Not 'less' condemnation — none. The guilt that remains may not be God's voice.
days.prayer: Stop me from re-sentencing what you have already pardoned.

days.note: Those who *wait* — not those who work harder. Strength comes out of waiting.
days.prayer: Let me choose waiting over hurry today.

days.note: He is *touched* with our infirmities. Not informed about them — He went through them.
days.prayer: I come to the one who has already stood where I stand.

days.note: God is not near after the broken heart is healed. He is near *to* the broken heart.
days.prayer: I believe this broken place is the closest place to you.

days.note: 'Loved *me*, and gave himself for *me*.' Singular. Not the crowd — me.
days.prayer: Let me know today that this love was aimed at me personally.

days.note: 'Thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.' Do not go fishing there.
days.prayer: Keep me from dredging up what you have thrown away.

days.note: 'Him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.' There is no exception clause.
days.prayer: Let me come without fearing I will be turned away.

days.note: Jonah tested this. He took a ship the other way, and God was already there.
days.prayer: I will stay before the One who knows even my urge to run.

days.note: God does not merely tolerate us — He rejoices over us. This is the hardest line to believe.
days.prayer: Help me accept that you delight in me rather than endure me.

days.note: 'If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful.' His faithfulness is not a response to ours.
days.prayer: When my faith shakes, I hold to the One who does not.

days.note: 'Come now, and let us reason together.' God opens the conversation. He is not avoiding us.
days.prayer: I will not hide; I will talk with you.

days.note: His first words from the cross were forgiveness — prayed for people who had not repented.
days.prayer: I know I was forgiven before I ever asked.

days.note: 'If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, who shall stand?' No one. That is why there is forgiveness.
days.prayer: I stand on your pardon, not on my record.

days.note: 'I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.' Love is the motive of the leading.
days.prayer: Let me read your guidance as love, not punishment.

days.note: 'Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.' Jesus answered that contradictory prayer.
days.prayer: I bring you the faith I have, uncertainty included.

days.note: He who began it will finish it. The completion is not our responsibility.
days.prayer: Even when I grow slowly, I trust you have not quit.

days.note: Forgiveness came when David stopped hiding. While he covered it, his bones wasted away.
days.prayer: Let me spend on confession the strength I spend on concealment.

days.note: 'All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way.' The problem is the words 'his own.'
days.prayer: I lay down my insistence on my own way.

days.note: 'Behold, I make all things new.' Not new things instead — these things, made new.
days.prayer: I trust you to renew the life I want to discard.

days.note: God is always the subject of the blessing. It is given, never earned.
days.prayer: Make your face shine upon me today.
